notes: Parts from step 1 are unchanged: 1 Uno, 1 breadboard, 1 pushbutton, 1 10k resistor, 5 jumper wires.
Breadboard coordinates are read from the image. The image's upper half (rows f-j) is catalogue bank 'b' and its lower half (rows a-e) is bank 't'. Columns are counted from the printed column numbers.
The button straddles the centre gap in columns 4 and 6. Column 4 is side 1 (5V side) and column 6 is side 2 (signal side).
Teal wire: Uno pin 2 to 6b.j, the button's column 6 strip. The 10k resistor runs from 6t.c to 9t.c, so it sits on the same side as the input pin (pull-down).
Orange wire: 4t.c to the + rail (bp.3), which puts 5V on the button's other leg. The short black wire runs from 9t.b to the - rail (bn.7), which grounds the resistor.
Red wire: Uno 5V to the + rail (bp.1). Black wire: Uno GND (second GND header pin, GND.2) to the - rail (bn.1).
Rail hole numbers are approximate. Each rail is one strip, so the exact hole does not change the circuit.
